title: factory board config
description: Every value loop.sh needs that is not a record. Setting the board up on another repo is editing this file (RUNBOOK.md). poll_seconds is what the open page waits between asks for data.json; watch_seconds is what the watch pane waits between collects. A record is drawn within poll_seconds + watch_seconds, so the two must sum to 30 or less (AC-H3 of WO-20261011-616c).

out_dir.description: where index.html and data.json are written, relative to the repository root; gitignored state
